CREATE TABLE browser_owners (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE login_rate_limits (
	client_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	attempts JSON NOT NULL, 
	blocked_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (client_key)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_clients (
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	secret_hash VARCHAR, 
	redirect_uris JSON NOT NULL, 
	auth_method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	grant_types JSON NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (client_id)
)

CREATE TABLE participants (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	managed_source VARCHAR DEFAULT 'config' NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE threads (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_fingerprint VARCHAR, 
	object_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	filename TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	lease VARCHAR, 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner_id, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
)

CREATE TABLE messages (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reply_to VARCHAR, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	needs_reply BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipient_sequence INTEGER, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (thread_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (recipient_id, recipient_sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES threads (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sender_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reply_to) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_users (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR, 
	managed_source VARCHAR DEFAULT 'config' NOT NULL, 
	creation_token_hash VARCHAR, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	api_key_hash VARCHAR, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	UNIQUE (email), 
	UNIQUE (api_key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	callback TEXT NOT NULL, 
	secret TEXT NOT NULL, 
	previous_secret TEXT, 
	rotation_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged_sequence INTEGER, 
	acknowledged_generation INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES participants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE thread_members (
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	participant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, participant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES threads (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(participant_id) REFERENCES participants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE deliveries (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	destination VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subscription_id VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	available_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	lease VARCHAR, 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	status INTEGER, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (message_id, destination), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE message_artifacts (
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (message_id, artifact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_families (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id)
)

CREATE TABLE work_claims (
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	claim_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (message_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	redirect_uri VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	resource VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	challenge VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	used BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(family) REFERENCES oauth_families (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_tokens (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	access_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	refresh_hash VARCHAR, 
	resource VARCHAR NOT NULL,

	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (client_id)
)

CREATE TABLE participants (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	managed_source VARCHAR DEFAULT 'config' NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	webhook_enabled BOOLEAN, 
	webhook_url TEXT, 
	webhook_token TEXT, 
	webhook_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE threads (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_fingerprint VARCHAR, 
	object_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	filename TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	lease VARCHAR, 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner_id, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
)

CREATE TABLE messages (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reply_to VARCHAR, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	needs_reply BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipient_sequence INTEGER, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (thread_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (recipient_id, recipient_sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES threads (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sender_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reply_to) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_users (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR, 
	managed_source VARCHAR DEFAULT 'config' NOT NULL, 
	creation_token_hash VARCHAR, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	api_key_hash VARCHAR, 
	credential_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	credential_baseline_set BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	configured_password_hash VARCHAR, 
	configured_api_key_hash VARCHAR, 
	password_source VARCHAR, 
	api_key_source VARCHAR, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	UNIQUE (email), 
	UNIQUE (api_key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	callback TEXT NOT NULL, 
	secret TEXT NOT NULL, 
	previous_secret TEXT, 
	rotation_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged_sequence INTEGER, 
	acknowledged_generation INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES participants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE thread_members (
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	participant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, participant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES threads (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(participant_id) REFERENCES participants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE credential_operations (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE deliveries (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	destination VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subscription_id VARCHAR, 
	webhook_generation INTEGER, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	available_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	lease VARCHAR, 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	status INTEGER, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (message_id, destination), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE message_artifacts (
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (message_id, artifact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_families (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id)
)

CREATE TABLE participant_api_keys (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL,

	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id),

)

	challenge VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	used BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id),

	PRIMARY KEY (client_id)
)

CREATE TABLE participants (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	managed_source VARCHAR DEFAULT 'config' NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	webhook_enabled BOOLEAN, 
	webhook_url TEXT, 
	webhook_token TEXT, 
	webhook_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE threads (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_fingerprint VARCHAR, 
	object_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	filename TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	lease VARCHAR, 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner_id, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	UNIQUE (object_key)
)

CREATE TABLE messages (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reply_to VARCHAR, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	needs_reply BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipient_sequence INTEGER, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (thread_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (recipient_id, recipient_sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES threads (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sender_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reply_to) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_users (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR, 
	managed_source VARCHAR DEFAULT 'config' NOT NULL, 
	creation_token_hash VARCHAR, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	api_key_hash VARCHAR, 
	credential_generation INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	credential_baseline_set BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	configured_password_hash VARCHAR, 
	configured_api_key_hash VARCHAR, 
	password_source VARCHAR, 
	api_key_source VARCHAR, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(id) REFERENCES participants (id), 
	UNIQUE (email), 
	UNIQUE (api_key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	callback TEXT NOT NULL, 
	secret TEXT NOT NULL, 
	previous_secret TEXT, 
	rotation_until FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged_sequence INTEGER, 
	acknowledged_generation INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES participants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE thread_members (
	thread_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	participant_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, participant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES threads (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(participant_id) REFERENCES participants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE credential_operations (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key_id VARCHAR, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE deliveries (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	destination VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subscription_id VARCHAR, 
	webhook_generation INTEGER, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	available_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	lease VARCHAR, 
	lease_until FLOAT, 
	status INTEGER, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (message_id, destination), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE message_artifacts (
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (message_id, artifact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_families (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id)
)

CREATE TABLE participant_api_keys (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	UNIQUE (key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE work_claims (
	message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	claim_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	claimed_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (message_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(message_id) REFERENCES messages (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_codes (
	code_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	redirect_uri VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	resource VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	challenge VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	used BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(family) REFERENCES oauth_families (id)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_tokens (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	client_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	access_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	refresh_hash VARCHAR, 
	resource VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	refresh_expires_at FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES oauth_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES oauth_clients (client_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(family) REFERENCES oauth_families (id), 
	UNIQUE (access_hash), 
	UNIQUE (refresh_hash)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_browser_owners_active_email ON browser_owners (email) WHERE active IS true
CREATE INDEX ix_login_rate_expiry ON login_rate_limits (expires_at, client_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_owner_id ON artifacts (owner_id)

CREATE INDEX ix_messages_thread_created_id ON messages (thread_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_messages_thread_id ON messages (thread_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_oauth_users_creation_token_hash ON oauth_users (creation_token_hash)
CREATE INDEX ix_subscriptions_owner_id ON subscriptions (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_thread_members_participant_thread ON thread_members (participant_id, thread_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_credential_operations_owner_id ON credential_operations (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_deliveries_available_at ON deliveries (available_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_deliveries_due ON deliveries (available_at, id) WHERE state IN ('pending', 'retry', 'sending')
CREATE INDEX ix_deliveries_message_id ON deliveries (message_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_deliveries_state ON deliveries (state)
CREATE INDEX ix_deliveries_subscription_message ON deliveries (subscription_id, message_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_oauth_families_client_id ON oauth_families (client_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_oauth_families_owner_id ON oauth_families (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_participant_api_keys_owner_id ON participant_api_keys (owner_id)

CREATE INDEX ix_oauth_tokens_client_id ON oauth_tokens (client_id)
